request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBTRN02C-002: Reject a transaction whose cross-referenced account does not exist

### given[0] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The card was found in the cross-reference file, so the failure reason is still 0 and the account lookup runs.

### given[1] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The account file is read using the 11-digit account ID taken from the cross-reference record.

### when[0] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): No account record exists for that account ID (keyed read returns INVALID KEY).

### then[0]: The failure reason is set to 101 and the description to 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'. Because the failure reason is no longer 0, the main loop adds 1 to the reject count and writes a reject record instead of posting the transaction.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['101', 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
   396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
>> 216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.
   220 

### then[1] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The credit-limit and expiration checks are in the NOT INVALID KEY branch, so they run only when the account record is found.

Give verdicts only for the clauses that are not marked already verified.

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]
